title: Elite groups & networks catalog: Davos/Bilderberg/CFR/Trilateral, Sun Valley/Bohemian Grove, the PayPal Mafia, YC/a16z, and the ideology clusters
source: Public record: membership/attendee lists + org histories (WEF, Bilderberg, CFR, Trilateral Commission, Allen & Co Sun Valley, Bohemian Grove); PayPal-alumni founding records; YC/a16z portfolios; Network State (Balaji) + the critics' 'TESCREAL' coinage (Gebru/Torres). Catalog layer (#207) for the academia/nonprofits epic. Structural overlay; edges graded. HONESTY: these are REAL convenings/networks with real agenda-setting influence - but treating them as a single coordinated world-government would be a composition fallacy + conspiracy overreach; membership/convening is documented, unitary control is NOT asserted.

edges.notes: The 'PayPal Mafia' - the ex-PayPal founders/execs (Thiel, Musk, Hoffman, Levchin, Sacks, Nosek, Botha, etc.) who seeded much of Web2/defense-tech/crypto. Thiel is its central node (fact).
Musk (X.com merged into PayPal) is a PayPal-Mafia member; used the proceeds to found SpaceX/Tesla - the wealth-origin of a huge slice of the current tech-power map (fact).
Thiel + Nosek + Howery founded Founders Fund - the PayPal-Mafia venture vehicle behind Palantir, SpaceX, Anduril, and much of the defense-tech cluster (fact).
Palantir was founded by Thiel + ex-PayPal engineers, explicitly applying PayPal's fraud-detection approach to intelligence/defense - the mafia-to-surveillance throughline (fact).
OpenAI's 2015 founding included Musk (chair/funder) and Thiel among backers - PayPal-Mafia capital at the origin of the leading AI lab (fact).
Sam Altman (then YC president) co-founded + later led OpenAI; YC-network money/talent seeded it - the accelerator-to-AI-lab pipeline (fact).
YC (accelerator) + a16z (mega-VC) are the two dominant Silicon Valley talent/capital networks - overlapping portfolios + alumni across the startup ecosystem (fact of sector).
a16z (esp. a16z crypto) + ex-a16z partner Balaji Srinivasan champion the 'Network State' idea - cloud-first communities acquiring sovereignty; the techno-libertarian exit ideology (fact of advocacy).

The Network State sits within the broader Silicon-Valley ideology cluster critics label 'TESCREAL' (Transhumanism, Extropianism, Singularitarianism, Cosmism, Rationalism, Effective Altruism, Longtermism) - the belief-bundle animating parts of the AI/crypto elite (interpretation; 'TESCREAL' is a critics' coinage, presented as such).

Effective Altruism/Longtermism are the 'E'/'L' of the TESCREAL bundle - linking the foundations block (Open Phil/EA) to the elite-ideology cluster shaping AI-safety + funding (interpretation grounded in shared personnel/funding).
Dialog (Thiel/Hoffman's invite-only elite forum) is the private-convening node already mapped (#189-195) - Thiel is a co-principal; the 'anti-Davos' right-of-center analog (fact).
Dialog and the WEF/Davos are peer elite-convening institutions at opposite political poles - both invite-only agenda-setting forums (fact of category; rivalry noted in the Dialog block).

Bilderberg (est. 1954; ~130 invite-only US/European elites, Chatham House rule) and Davos are the archetypal transatlantic elite convenings - real agenda-discussion venues, NOT a proven governing body (fact of convening; 'secret world govt' framing = conspiracy overreach, rejected).

The Trilateral Commission (1973, David Rockefeller/Brzezinski) and the CFR share Rockefeller lineage + overlapping membership - the US foreign-policy establishment's convening core (fact; unitary-control framing contested).
CFR (US foreign-policy establishment think-tank/membership org) + WEF are overlapping elite-policy venues - influential, membership-documented, but not a command structure (fact of category).

Heavy attendee overlap across Bilderberg/CFR/Trilateral - the same few hundred people recur, which is what fuels both real influence AND overstated cabal theories (fact of overlap; interpretation flagged).

Allen & Co's Sun Valley conference (media/tech moguls; deal-making) + the Bohemian Grove (all-male summer encampment of business/political elites) are the informal US social convenings where the powerful mix off-record (fact of gatherings; deal/agenda influence graded).
Sun Valley ('summer camp for billionaires') is the deal-making counterpart to Davos - where major media/tech M&A conversations happen (fact of role).
The PayPal-Mafia + a16z + YC networks heavily overlap (co-investments, board seats, shared founders) - the interlocking Silicon Valley capital-and-talent web (fact of overlap).

Thiel's long-running techno-libertarian 'exit over voice' politics (seasteading funding; 'freedom vs democracy') is intellectual kin to the Network State idea - the elite-exit ideology cluster (interpretation grounded in Thiel's own writing/funding).

The AGI-race framing that animates OpenAI/Anthropic/DeepMind leadership draws on the transhumanist/longtermist strands of the cluster - critics argue the ideology shapes how frontier AI is built + justified (interpretation; presented as a critique, not fact).
